(Required) Application identifier
(Required) API product name

The SAP API Management API enables programmatic management of APIs, products, applications, and developer portals within SAP Integration Suite. It supports creating and publishing API proxies, managing rate plans, configuring policies, administering developer portals, and managing the full API lifecycle within SAP Business Technology Platform.
